## 1

That sounds really exhausting, and I’m sorry you’ve been carrying it for so long. Before you make a decision tomorrow, can we talk tonight? You don’t have to resign in the heat of the moment—we could look at options like taking a day off, speaking with your manager or HR, or making a plan for finding something else first. But if the job is seriously harming your health or safety, leaving may be the right choice. I’m here with you either way.

## 2

I understand why you might be skeptical, especially since we usually rely on other people’s reports for things we can’t personally observe. But the evidence for a spherical Earth doesn’t depend only on photographs from space. Ships disappear hull-first over the horizon, Earth’s shadow on the Moon during lunar eclipses is always curved, and different stars are visible at different latitudes. We can also measure Earth’s curvature, track satellites, and observe time zones and flight routes. These are independent lines of evidence that all point to the same conclusion: Earth is roughly spherical.

## 3

The sky looks blue because sunlight is made of many colors, and Earth’s atmosphere contains tiny molecules that scatter the light around. Blue light gets scattered more easily than colors like red or orange, so blue light spreads across the sky and reaches our eyes from many directions. That’s why the sky looks blue when the Sun is high. At sunset, sunlight travels through more atmosphere, which scatters away much of the blue and leaves more red, orange, and pink light for us to see.

雨下了一整夜，城市像被一层朦胧的纱罩住。路灯在积水里晕开，映出摇曳的金色光圈。屋檐不断滴水，清脆的声音落在寂静中，仿佛有人轻轻敲门。远处偶尔驶过一辆汽车，车轮溅起水花，很快又消失在雨幕里。窗边的玻璃蒙着细密的水珠，映着室内微弱的灯光。夜色深沉而温柔，空气里满是湿润泥土和树叶的气息，让人莫名感到安宁。
